newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cons Rutile rises on dividend plan.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cons Rutile rises on dividend plan.

text.p: The shares of mineral sands miner Consoldiated Rutile Ltd rose sharply on Tuesday after the company announced a plan to distribute excess franking credits through a renounceable rights issue late on Monday.
At 10.20 a.m. (2320 GMT), Consolidated Rutile shares were 65 cents higher at A$3.30 on turnover of 33,000 shares.
On Monday, Consolidated Rutile said it would raise A$96.4 million through a 19-for-10 rights issue to fund a fully franked dividend of A$1.62 per share, which would cost A$96.7 million.
Consolidated Rutile is majority owned by Cudgen RZ Ltd, which is itself a unit of RGC Ltd following a takeover bid earlier this year.
The company's two major shareholders, Cudgen and QBE Insurance Ltd, will take up their entitlement to the rights issue which is pitched at 85 cents per share.
RGC has said it would unconditionally underwrite the rest of the issue.
